request.style: English, triumphant anthem, a solo tenor in the verses, then a huge choir and orchestra with brass fanfares and drums, slow start rising to a majestic chorus, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Though he was in the form of God
He did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped
He emptied himself, taking the form of a servant
Being born in the likeness of men

[Verse]
And being found in human form
He humbled himself
By becoming obedient to the point of death
Even death on a cross

[Chorus]
Therefore God has highly exalted him
And given him the name above every name
That at the name of Jesus every knee shall bow
And every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord

[Outro]
To the glory of God the Father
